name: Envoy proxy
description: A downstream HTTP request through Envoy 1.36.2: filter chain match, the HTTP connection manager and its codec limits, local rate limiting and RBAC, the route table (virtual host, then route, with a direct response and a redirect), and the router filter with its timeouts and retry policy, over the cluster manager's round-robin load balancer, circuit breakers, outlier detection and connection pool, to upstream hosts modeled as instances. The response returns through the connection manager, which writes the access log with Envoy's response flags. Outlier ejections are delivered after the request, as Envoy posts them to the main thread.

components.name: Downstream client
components.summary: An HTTP/1.1 client calling the proxy.

components.name: Envoy
components.summary: The proxy process; one worker thread handles the connection.

components.name: Listener
components.summary: Accepts the connection and picks a filter chain by the connection's addresses.

components.name: HTTP connection manager
components.summary: The network filter that turns bytes into streams, resolves the route, runs the HTTP filters and logs the stream.

components.name: HTTP/1 codec
components.summary: Parses request headers and enforces the header size limit.

components.name: Filter manager
components.summary: Runs the decoder filters in order until one stops iteration.

components.name: Local rate limit filter
components.summary: A token bucket shared by the worker's requests; an empty bucket answers 429.

components.name: RBAC filter
components.summary: Role-based access control; a DENY policy that matches answers 403.

components.name: Router filter
components.summary: The terminal filter. Sends direct responses and redirects, sets the timeouts and forwards to the cluster, retrying per the route's policy.

components.name: Retry state
components.summary: Decides each retry from retry_on, the retries left and the cluster's retry circuit breaker.

components.name: Upstream request
components.summary: One attempt. Picks a host, gets a stream from the pool, sends, and reports the outcome to outlier detection and the retry state.

components.name: Route matcher
components.summary: Finds the virtual host by the authority header, then asks it for the first matching route.

components.name: Virtual host
components.summary: Walks its routes in order and returns the first whose path and header matchers match.

components.name: Cluster manager
components.summary: The worker's thread-local clusters, their host sets and host health.

components.name: Round-robin load balancer
components.summary: Picks hosts in turn from the healthy set, starting at a random index.

components.name: Circuit breakers
components.summary: The cluster's resource manager. Counts connections, pending requests, requests and retries against their maximums.

components.name: Connection pool
components.summary: Per-host HTTP/1 pool. Attaches to a ready connection, or queues a pending stream and connects.

components.name: Outlier detector
components.summary: Counts consecutive 5xx per host and ejects a host at the threshold, within max_ejection_percent.

components.name: Access log
components.summary: The stream's access log line, written when the stream ends.

components.name: Cluster backend
components.summary: Three interchangeable application hosts.

components.name: Backend host
components.summary: One host of cluster backend; its instances are h1, h2 and h3.

components.name: Cluster canary
components.summary: A single canary host, selected by header.

components.name: Canary host
components.summary: The canary host, instance c1.

interfaces.name: accept
interfaces.summary: A new downstream connection on 0.0.0.0:10000.

behavior.title: Match a filter chain
behavior.detail: Without a destination-port sub-tree, the catch-all port is searched by source address; with no match and no default chain, nothing serves the connection.

then.title: Close the connection
then.detail: No filter chain matches, so the listener sets NR, writes its access log and closes the socket; no HTTP response is sent.

interfaces.name: on-request
interfaces.summary: One HTTP stream, from request headers to the access log.

then.title: Resolve the route
then.detail: The route is resolved once, before the first filter, and cached for the stream.

behavior.title: Write the access log
behavior.detail: The stream's log line is written when the stream is destroyed, with its response flags joined by commas, or "-" when there are none.

then.title: Encode the error response
then.detail: Every response, local or upstream, gets the server header.

interfaces.name: decode-headers
interfaces.summary: Parses the request headers against max_request_headers_kb.

then.title: Reject oversized headers
then.detail: The codec answers 431 itself, and the connection manager marks the stream DPE (downstream protocol error) and closes the connection.

interfaces.name: decode-headers
interfaces.summary: local_ratelimit, then rbac, then router; a filter that sends a local reply stops the chain.

interfaces.name: decode-headers
interfaces.summary: Takes one token from the bucket, or answers 429 local_rate_limited.

behavior.title: Answer 429
behavior.detail: The filter sends a local reply with body local_rate_limited and sets RL.

interfaces.name: decode-headers
interfaces.summary: Evaluates the enforced engine; a matched DENY policy answers 403.

behavior.title: Apply the action
behavior.detail: ALLOW allows when a policy matches; DENY allows when none does.

behavior.title: Answer 403
behavior.detail: The details name the matched policy; RBAC sets no response flag.

interfaces.name: route
interfaces.summary: Picks the virtual host by exact domain, then delegates to its routes.

behavior.title: Find the virtual host
behavior.detail: The host header is lower-cased and looked up among the domains; there are no wildcard domains and no default virtual host here.

interfaces.name: get-route
interfaces.summary: The first route, in order, whose path and headers match.

steps.title: Match path, then headers
steps.detail: A prefix or exact path must match, and every header matcher must match.
steps.if: (has(vars.r.match.path) ? input.path == vars.r.match.path : input.path.startsWith(vars.r.match.prefix)) && (!has(vars.r.match.headers) || vars.r.match.headers.all(h, h.name in input.headers && input.headers[h.name] == h.exact))

interfaces.name: decode-headers
interfaces.summary: Direct response, redirect, or forward to the route's cluster with its timeout and retry policy.

then.title: No route
then.detail: The router answers 404 with an empty body and sets NR.

then.title: Redirect
then.detail: A redirect is a direct response with a Location header; https_redirect swaps the scheme and the default code is 301.

behavior.title: Set the timeouts and retry policy
behavior.detail: The route timeout defaults to 15 s; a per-try timeout at or above it is ignored; num_retries defaults to 1 when a policy is present.

retry.title: Retry with back-off
retry.detail: A fully jittered exponential back-off from 25 ms, capped at 250 ms, then a new host pick.

then.title: Upstream request timeout
then.detail: The router answers 504 "upstream request timeout" and sets UT.

then.title: Dropped by a circuit breaker
then.detail: An overflow reset is cluster-wide, so it is neither retried nor charged to the host; the 503 carries x-envoy-overloaded.

fail.message: = 'upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. ' + vars.retried + 'reset reason: overflow'

on_error.title: Reset before headers
on_error.detail: A connection failure sets UF, a remote reset UR; the 503 body names the latest reset reason.

fail.message: = 'upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. ' + vars.retried + 'reset reason: ' + error.data.reason + (error.data.transport != '' ? ', transport failure reason: ' + error.data.transport : '')

behavior.title: Forward the upstream response
behavior.detail: The router adds x-envoy-upstream-service-time, measured from the end of the downstream request to the upstream headers.

interfaces.name: send
interfaces.summary: One attempt against one host.

then.title: Route timeout during back-off
then.detail: The global timer fired while the retry was waiting; no attempt is made.

behavior.title: Send to the host
behavior.detail: The per-try timeout, when set, bounds this attempt; the route timeout, armed when the request completed, bounds every attempt together.
behavior.timeout_ms: = input.per_try_timeout_ms > 0 && input.per_try_timeout_ms < ctx.deadlineAt - now ? input.per_try_timeout_ms : ctx.deadlineAt - now

then.title: Route timeout
then.detail: The global timeout fired; it is recorded as a local-origin timeout and never retried.

then.title: Per-try timeout
then.detail: The attempt is reset locally, recorded as a timeout, and offered to the retry state as a local reset.

then.title: Connection failure or reset
then.detail: A refused connection is a pool failure (remote connection failure) whose transport reason is the connect errno; a reset is a remote reset. Both count as a connect failure, a 503, for outlier detection.

behavior.title: Response headers
behavior.detail: The status goes to outlier detection, then to the retry state.

interfaces.name: should-retry
interfaces.summary: shouldRetryHeaders and shouldRetryReset. Sets ctx.retryStatus to yes, no, limit_exceeded or overflow.

behavior.title: Would this be retried?
behavior.detail: A status retries under 5xx, gateway-error or a listed retriable status code. An overflow reset never retries; a connection failure retries under connect-failure, and any other reset under reset, 5xx or gateway-error.

set.vars.would:
= input.kind == 'headers'
  ? (('5xx' in ctx.retryOn && input.status >= 500) ||
     ('gateway-error' in ctx.retryOn && input.status in [502, 503, 504]) ||
     ('retriable-status-codes' in ctx.retryOn && input.status in ctx.retriableStatusCodes))
  : (input.reason != 'overflow' &&
     ((input.reason == 'remote connection failure' && 'connect-failure' in ctx.retryOn) ||
      'reset' in ctx.retryOn || '5xx' in ctx.retryOn || 'gateway-error' in ctx.retryOn))

then.title: Retries exhausted
then.detail: The policy's retries are spent; the response or reset goes downstream with URX.

then.title: Retry circuit breaker open
then.detail: The cluster already has max_retries retries outstanding; this one is not attempted and the stream gets UO.

interfaces.name: reset
interfaces.summary: Gives back the retry circuit-breaker slot held by an armed retry.

interfaces.name: choose-host
interfaces.summary: The thread-local cluster's healthy hosts, or all of them in panic, handed to the load balancer.

behavior.title: Healthy hosts, unless in panic
behavior.detail: Below the healthy panic threshold (50%) the load balancer uses every host.

interfaces.name: eject-host
interfaces.summary: The main thread marks the host FAILED_OUTLIER_CHECK and pushes the new host set to the workers.

interfaces.name: pick
interfaces.summary: Round robin over the given hosts from a per-source index seeded at random.

then.title: Seed the index
then.detail: The index starts at the load balancer's random seed, so the first host differs between workers and restarts.

interfaces.name: try-acquire
interfaces.summary: canCreate, then inc, for one resource.

set.vars.current: = input.resource == 'connections' ? state.connections : input.resource == 'pending' ? state.pending : input.resource == 'requests' ? state.requests : state.retries

interfaces.name: release
interfaces.summary: dec for one resource.

interfaces.name: new-stream
interfaces.summary: A stream on a ready connection, or a pending stream and a new connection, each gated by a circuit breaker.

then.title: Queue a pending stream
then.detail: No connection is ready, so the stream waits for one, under max_pending_requests.

then.title: Connect
then.detail: A host with no connections always gets one, even at max_connections.

behavior.title: Attach the stream
behavior.detail: Attaching a stream to a connection needs a slot under max_requests.

interfaces.name: release-stream
interfaces.summary: The stream ends and its request slot is freed.

interfaces.name: put-result
interfaces.summary: putHttpResponseCode. A 5xx adds to the host's consecutive count; anything else resets it.

behavior.title: Consecutive 5xx threshold
behavior.detail: The host is ejected only if one more ejection stays within max_ejection_percent; the count resets either way.

then.title: Eject the host
then.detail: The worker posts the ejection to the main thread, which updates the host set for later requests.

interfaces.name: log
interfaces.summary: One access log line.

behavior.title: Write the line
behavior.detail: The default format carries the response code, flags, upstream service time and upstream host.

interfaces.name: handle
interfaces.summary: The application. A stub; responses come from its schema.

interfaces.name: handle
interfaces.summary: The canary build of the application. A stub.

entry.description: The matched route entry, or null

flows.description: One HTTP/1.1 request from a client on a private network, through the listener, connection manager, filters and router to an upstream host and back.
